usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.beta.chat_kit.threads.items.list("cthr_123", limit=1, order="asc", after="after", before="before")
print(result)

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum number of thread items to return. Defaults to 20.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order for results by creation time. Defaults to `desc`.

fields.name: after
fields.description: List items created after this thread item ID. Defaults to null for the first page.

fields.name: before
fields.description: List items created before this thread item ID. Defaults to null for the newest results.
